subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v3

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Ecologists counted a herbivore population and its main predator in the same reserve at the end of each year.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage increase in the herbivore population from year 1 to year 3.
markscheme: Increase = 210 − 120 = 90 individuals.
Percentage increase = 90 ÷ 120 × 100 = 75%.
parts.modelAnswer: The herbivore population increased by 90 individuals, which is 90 ÷ 120 × 100 = 75%.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 草食動物個体群は90個体増加し、90÷120×100＝75%の増加です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the timing of changes in the herbivore and predator populations.
markscheme: The herbivore population rises first, reaching a peak in year 3.
The predator population reaches its highest value later, in year 4, showing a lag behind the herbivore increase.
markschemeJa: 草食動物個体群が先に増加し、3年目に最大になる。
捕食者個体群はその後の4年目に最大となり、草食動物の増加より遅れて変化している。
parts.modelAnswer: The herbivore population peaks in year 3, while the predator population peaks in year 4, so the predator response lags behind the herbivore change.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 草食動物は3年目、捕食者は4年目に最大となるため、捕食者の変化は草食動物より遅れています。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how density-dependent factors could limit further growth of the herbivore population when its density is high.
markscheme: At high population density, competition for limited resources such as food, water or space becomes stronger.
Disease or parasite transmission may increase because individuals encounter each other more frequently.
Higher density can therefore reduce survival and/or reproductive success, lowering the population growth rate.
markschemeJa: 個体群密度が高いと、食物、水、空間など限られた資源をめぐる競争が強くなる。
個体どうしの接触が増えるため、病気や寄生生物の伝播が増える可能性がある。
その結果、生存率や繁殖成功が低下し、個体群増加率が下がる。
parts.modelAnswer: High density intensifies competition and can increase disease transmission. These density-dependent effects reduce survival or reproduction and slow population growth.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 高密度では競争が激しくなり、病気の伝播も増える可能性があります。こうした密度依存要因が生存や繁殖を低下させ、個体群増加を遅くします。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Infer one possible predator–prey relationship from the data and predict what would happen to the predator population if herbivore numbers remained low for several years.
markscheme: The predator increase after the herbivore increase is consistent with predator numbers responding to greater prey availability.
If herbivore numbers remained low, the predator population would be expected to decrease after a delay because less food would support lower survival/reproduction.
markschemeJa: 草食動物の増加後に捕食者が増えており、捕食者数が餌となる獲物量に反応している可能性と一致する。
草食動物が数年間少ないままなら、餌不足によって生存・繁殖が低下し、時間差を伴って捕食者個体群も減少すると予想される。
parts.modelAnswer: The delayed predator increase is consistent with a response to prey availability. If herbivores stayed scarce, predator numbers would probably fall after a lag because less food would support fewer predators.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 捕食者の遅れた増加は獲物量への反応と考えられます。草食動物が少ない状態が続けば、餌不足により時間差を伴って捕食者も減少すると予想されます。

parts.label: (e)
parts.question: Evaluate whether these annual counts are sufficient to conclude that predator abundance controls the herbivore population.
markscheme: The lagged pattern is consistent with an interaction between predator and herbivore populations but shows correlation rather than direct proof of causation.
Other factors such as food supply, disease, weather, migration or sampling error could also change herbivore abundance.
More frequent counts, replicate sites and/or independent evidence on predation rates would strengthen the conclusion.
markschemeJa: 時間差を伴う変化は捕食者と草食動物の相互作用と一致するが、相関であり因果関係を直接証明するものではない。
食物量、病気、天候、移動、標本誤差など他の要因も草食動物数を変化させうる。
より頻繁な調査、複数地点での反復、捕食率の独立した測定などを追加すると結論が強くなる。
parts.modelAnswer: The data are consistent with predator–prey interaction, but annual counts alone cannot prove that predators control herbivore numbers. Other variables could produce the pattern, so more frequent replicated monitoring and direct evidence of predation are needed.
parts.modelAnswerJa: データは捕食者‐被食者関係と一致しますが、年1回の個体数だけでは捕食者が草食動物数を制御していると証明できません。より頻繁で反復された調査や直接的な捕食データが必要です。

stimulus.title: Herbivore and predator populations
stimulus.note: Counts were made using the same survey method each year.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Water uptake was measured in similar leafy shoots exposed to different relative humidities.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate how many times greater the mean water-uptake rate is at 40% relative humidity than at 80% relative humidity.
markscheme: Rate ratio = 1.8 ÷ 0.6 = 3 times.
parts.modelAnswer: The water-uptake rate at 40% humidity is 3 times the rate at 80% humidity.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 相対湿度40%での吸水速度は80%の3倍です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why lower relative humidity can increase water loss from leaves.
markscheme: Lower external humidity produces a steeper water-vapour concentration gradient between moist leaf air spaces and the surrounding air.
Water vapour therefore diffuses out through stomata more rapidly, increasing transpiration.
markschemeJa: 外気の湿度が低いと、湿った葉内空間と外気の間の水蒸気濃度勾配が大きくなる。
そのため水蒸気が気孔からより速く拡散し、蒸散が増加する。
parts.modelAnswer: Lower humidity increases the water-vapour gradient from the leaf to the air, so diffusion through stomata and transpiration increase.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 湿度が低いと葉から外気への水蒸気濃度勾配が大きくなり、気孔からの拡散と蒸散が増えます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how cohesion between water molecules contributes to transport of water through xylem.
markscheme: Hydrogen bonding causes water molecules to cohere to one another, helping maintain a continuous water column in xylem vessels.
Tension generated by transpiration can therefore be transmitted down the water column, pulling water upward through the plant.
markschemeJa: 水素結合により水分子どうしが凝集し、木部道管内で連続した水柱を保ちやすくなる。
蒸散によって生じる張力が水柱を通して下方へ伝わり、水を植物内で上方へ引き上げることができる。
parts.modelAnswer: Cohesion keeps water molecules linked in a continuous xylem column, allowing transpiration-generated tension to pull water upward.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 凝集により木部内で連続した水柱が保たれ、蒸散で生じた張力によって水を上方へ引き上げることができます。

stimulus.title: Relative humidity and water uptake
stimulus.note: Temperature, light intensity and leaf area were kept constant.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Species richness was recorded in three forest fragments before and four years after wildlife corridors were established between fragments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the forest fragment with the greatest species richness after corridor establishment.
markscheme: Fragment R, with 31 recorded species.
markschemeJa: 回廊設置後の種数が31で最も多い断片R。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage increase in species richness in fragment Q after corridor establishment.
markscheme: Increase = 27 − 20 = 7 species.
Percentage increase = 7 ÷ 20 × 100 = 35%.
parts.modelAnswer: Species richness in Q increased by 7 species, which is 7 ÷ 20 × 100 = 35%.
parts.modelAnswerJa: Qでは種数が7増え、7÷20×100＝35%の増加です。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how habitat corridors can contribute to conservation of biodiversity in fragmented habitats.
markscheme: Corridors allow movement and dispersal of organisms between habitat fragments, reducing isolation of populations.
Movement between fragments can maintain gene flow and allow recolonization after local population decline or extinction.
markschemeJa: 回廊は生息地断片間の移動・分散を可能にし、個体群の孤立を減らす。
断片間の移動によって遺伝子流動を維持し、局所的な個体群減少や絶滅後の再定着を可能にできる。
parts.modelAnswer: Corridors reduce isolation by allowing dispersal between fragments. This can maintain gene flow and permit recolonization, helping populations persist.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 回廊は断片間の分散を可能にして孤立を減らします。遺伝子流動や再定着を助けるため、個体群の維持につながります。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one limitation of using species richness alone to judge the success of the conservation programme.
markscheme: Species richness does not show population sizes, genetic diversity, abundance/evenness, or whether the additional species are native and self-sustaining.
markschemeJa: 種数だけでは個体群サイズ、遺伝的多様性、個体数の均等性、増加した種が在来種で持続的かどうかなどは分からない。
parts.modelAnswer: Species richness alone does not show whether populations are large, genetically diverse or stable.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 種数だけでは、個体群が十分大きいか、遺伝的に多様か、安定しているかは分かりません。

stimulus.title: Species richness in forest fragments
stimulus.note: The same standardized survey effort was used before and after corridor establishment.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Two insect populations experienced different environments over 20 generations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the change in allele X frequency in the dry environment.
markscheme: Allele X frequency increases steadily from 0.12 at generation 0 to 0.76 at generation 20.
The increase becomes substantial over successive generations rather than occurring as a single-step change.
markschemeJa: 乾燥環境ではXの頻度が世代0の0.12から世代20の0.76まで継続的に増加する。
変化は一度に起こるのではなく、複数世代にわたり大きくなる。
parts.modelAnswer: Allele X rises steadily from 0.12 to 0.76 across 20 generations.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 対立遺伝子Xは20世代で0.12から0.76へ継続的に増加します。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the allele-frequency pattern in the dry and moist environments.
markscheme: Allele X rises strongly in the dry environment but remains close to the starting frequency in the moist environment.
markschemeJa: Xは乾燥環境で大きく増えるが、湿潤環境では開始頻度付近にとどまる。
parts.modelAnswer: X increases strongly in the dry environment but changes little in the moist environment.
parts.modelAnswerJa: Xは乾燥環境では大きく増えますが、湿潤環境ではほとんど変化しません。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how natural selection could produce the observed difference between environments.
markscheme: If allele X increases survival or reproductive success in the dry environment, carriers contribute more offspring to the next generation.
Because the advantage depends on environment, the selection pressure may be weak or absent in the moist environment, so allele frequency changes little there.
markschemeJa: Xが乾燥環境で生存・繁殖成功を高めるなら、保有個体が次世代へより多くの子孫を残す。
利点が環境依存なら湿潤環境では選択圧が弱い・ないため、頻度はほとんど変化しない。
parts.modelAnswer: If X improves fitness in dry conditions, carriers leave more offspring and X becomes more common. If it gives little advantage in moist conditions, its frequency changes much less there.
parts.modelAnswerJa: Xが乾燥条件で適応度を高めれば保有個体がより多く繁殖し、Xが増えます。湿潤条件で利点が小さければ頻度変化も小さくなります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Answer all parts about DNA composition and replication.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: A double-stranded DNA sample contains 18% guanine. Calculate the expected percentages of cytosine and adenine.
markscheme: Cytosine is 18% because guanine pairs with cytosine.
G + C = 36%, leaving 64% for A + T; adenine is therefore 32%.
markschemeJa: グアニンとシトシンは対になるため、シトシンは18%。
G+C＝36%なのでA+Tは64%、したがってアデニンは32%。
parts.modelAnswerJa: シトシン18%、アデニン32%です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain how complementary base pairing contributes to accurate DNA replication.
markscheme: Each parental strand acts as a template, and exposed bases pair specifically with complementary nucleotides.
A pairs with T and C pairs with G, so the nucleotide sequence of each new strand is determined by the template sequence.
markschemeJa: 各親鎖が鋳型となり、露出した塩基に相補的ヌクレオチドが特異的に結合する。
AはT、CはGと対合するため、新生鎖の塩基配列は鋳型配列によって決まる。
parts.modelAnswer: Each parental strand is a template. Specific A–T and C–G pairing determines the sequence of the new complementary strand.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 各親鎖が鋳型となり、A-T、C-Gの特異的な対合によって新しい相補鎖の配列が決まります。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why DNA replication is described as semi-conservative.
markscheme: The two parental DNA strands separate before new complementary strands are synthesized.
Each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesized strand.
markschemeJa: 親DNAの2本鎖が分離してから新しい相補鎖が合成される。
複製後の各DNA分子は親由来の鎖1本と新生鎖1本を含む。
parts.modelAnswer: The parental strands separate and each templates a new strand, so each daughter molecule contains one old strand and one new strand.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 親鎖が分かれてそれぞれ新生鎖の鋳型となるため、各娘DNAは親鎖1本と新生鎖1本を含みます。
